content.title: LGI Homes (LGIH): Margin Decline Challenges Bullish Turnaround Narrative Despite Strong Earnings Forecast
content.summary: LGI Homes (LGIH) delivered a net profit margin of 5.9% in the latest reporting period, a drop from last year’s 8.8%, marking another year in which profitability has slipped. Over the past five years, the company’s earnings declined at an average annual rate of 20.4%. However, forecasts now suggest a sharp turnaround, with earnings expected to surge 27.4% per year and revenue projected to rise 17.4% annually.
